title: Optimize projection result preallocation
constraints: Preserve non-GROUP BY projection, expression, and window projection semantics
rationale: The non-GROUP BY projection path knows both the input row count and projection width before building projected rows. Preallocating the outer result vector and per-row projection vector reduces allocator growth during SELECT projection.
steps: Preallocate projected_rows from input row count
Preallocate each projected row from projection item count
Verify normal, constant, expression, and window projection behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in SELECT projection without changing result values or ordering.
